landing.heroDescription: Dimewise helps families manage shared household expenses without the spreadsheets, guesswork, or awkward conversations. Track spending, set budgets, and settle up — together.

benefits.realTime: See every expense in real time
benefits.fairSplits: Fair splits — down to the cent
benefits.installable: Installable as an app on any device
benefits.anyDevice: Works on any phone, tablet, or desktop

features.title: Built for real households
features.description: Whether you're a couple sharing rent, parents managing the family budget, or housemates splitting groceries — Dimewise keeps it transparent and fair.

household.title: One Household, One Source of Truth
household.description: Create your family household, invite everyone, and keep all shared spending in a single place.

expenses.title: Log & Split Expenses Fairly
expenses.description: Groceries, rent, utilities, subscriptions — log any expense and split it evenly or by custom amounts.

budgets.title: Set Budgets That Stick
budgets.description: Create monthly budget categories so your household knows exactly where the money goes.

reports.title: Monthly Settlement Reports
reports.description: At month's end, see who owes whom. Mark transfers as paid and keep everyone accountable.

step1.title: Create your household
step1.description: Sign up, name your household, and invite family members with a simple code.

step2.title: Log expenses as they happen
step2.description: Anyone in the household can add an expense. Dimewise splits it automatically.

step3.title: Settle up each month
step3.description: Review the monthly report, see who owes whom, and mark transfers as paid.

cta.title: Take the guesswork out of family finances
cta.description: Free to use. Set up your household in under a minute.
cta.pwa: Works on any device — install it like a native app from your browser

footer.copyright: © {{year}} Dimewise. Built with love for families who share more than just a roof.
